segments.text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.
When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning,
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: while you searched out what to say.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job,
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: or who answered his words, among you.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
segments.speaker: Elihu
